segments.source: Today, thanks to deep learning algorithms of artificial intelligence, we have the possibility to automate the classification of images, so this tool can help medical personnel in the classification and early detection of breast cancer. In this way, women suffering from this disease could be diagnosed automatically, in time to start treatment.
segments.en: Today, thanks to deep learning algorithms of artificial intelligence, we have the possibility to automate the classification of images, so this tool can help medical personnel in the classification and early detection of breast cancer. In this way, women suffering from this disease could be diagnosed automatically, in time to start treatment.
segments.es: Hoy en día, gracias a los algoritmos de aprendizaje profundo de la inteligencia artificial, tenemos la posibilidad de automatizar la clasificación de imágenes, por lo que esta herramienta puede ayudar al personal médico en la clasificación y detección temprana del cáncer de mama. De esta forma, las mujeres que padecen esta enfermedad podrían ser diagnosticadas de forma automática, a tiempo para iniciar el tratamiento.

segments.source: Breast cancer is the most common type of cancer in women and is also one of the main causes of death according to the WHO (WHO, 2020). Early detection is the single most important factor in lowering cancer treatment costs and mortality. To make it possible it is necessary to have medical ultrasound images and specialists who can explain them. However, the lack of these creates a gap in access to early treatment in countries with little or not enough access to specialized diagnostic services and whose population receives low and middle income.
segments.en: Breast cancer is the most common type of cancer in women and is also one of the main causes of death according to the WHO (WHO, 2020). Early detection is the single most important factor in lowering cancer treatment costs and mortality. To make it possible it is necessary to have medical ultrasound images and specialists who can explain them. However, the lack of these creates a gap in access to early treatment in countries with little or not enough access to specialized diagnostic services and whose population receives low and middle income.
segments.es: El cáncer de mama es el tipo de cáncer más común en las mujeres y también es una de las principales causas de muerte según la OMS (OMS, 2020). La detección temprana es el factor más importante para reducir los costos del tratamiento del cáncer y la mortalidad. Para que esto sea posible es necesario contar con imágenes ecográficas médicas y especialistas que puedan explicarlas. Sin embargo, la falta de estos crea una brecha en el acceso al tratamiento temprano en países con poco o insuficiente acceso a servicios de diagnóstico especializados y cuya población recibe ingresos bajos y medios.

segments.source: Our project consists of the detection and classification of breast cancer in women between 25 and 75 years old. This is possible from the development of an deep learning model trained with images obtained using ultrasound scanners that result in the segmentation of the type of cancer that could be suffered.
segments.en: Our project consists of the detection and classification of breast cancer in women between 25 and 75 years old. This is possible from the development of an deep learning model trained with images obtained using ultrasound scanners that result in the segmentation of the type of cancer that could be suffered.
segments.es: Nuestro proyecto consiste en la detección y clasificación del cáncer de mama en mujeres entre 25 y 75 años. Esto es posible a partir del desarrollo de un modelo de aprendizaje profundo entrenado con imágenes obtenidas mediante ecógrafos que dan como resultado la segmentación del tipo de cáncer que se podría padecer.

segments.source: Allow women suffering from breast cancer to be automatically diagnosed using a deep learning model so that they can start treatment early and safely, reducing costs and the mortality rate. To meet this objective, we have proposed a tool that uses artificial intelligence to provide greater agility to the process through self-diagnosis with ultrasound images.
segments.en: Allow women suffering from breast cancer to be automatically diagnosed using a deep learning model so that they can start treatment early and safely, reducing costs and the mortality rate. To meet this objective, we have proposed a tool that uses artificial intelligence to provide greater agility to the process through self-diagnosis with ultrasound images.
segments.es: Permitir que las mujeres que padecen cáncer de mama sean diagnosticadas automáticamente mediante un modelo de aprendizaje profundo para que puedan iniciar el tratamiento de forma temprana y segura, reduciendo costes y la tasa de mortalidad. Para cumplir con este objetivo hemos propuesto una herramienta que utiliza inteligencia artificial para dotar de mayor agilidad al proceso mediante el autodiagnóstico con imágenes ecográficas.
